easy.statement_latex: Triangles $ABC$ and $DEF$ are similar. Corresponding sides $AB$ and $DE$ have lengths $12$ and $6$. If side $BC$ has length $8$, find the length of the corresponding side $EF$.
hints: In similar triangles, corresponding sides are in the same ratio. Set up a proportion.
Write: $\dfrac{AB}{DE} = \dfrac{BC}{EF}$.
Substitute the known values and solve for $EF$.
solution_steps_latex: Set up a proportion from corresponding sides: $\dfrac{12}{6} = \dfrac{8}{EF}$.
Cross-multiply: $12 \cdot EF = 6 \cdot 8$.
Divide: $EF = \dfrac{6 \cdot 8}{12} = 4$.
